active_prompt.step: SP-019 is completed: all eight R8 live/product scenarios passed on the single build fccf1520 under EV-SP-019-20260825-CONSOLIDATED-ACCEPTANCE-14. SP-020 (remote context boundary and ADR-043) is next and unopened.

summary: SP-019 second attempt. Four of the five scenarios still open were traced to missing product paths rather than failed procedures: no production site wrote MemoryClass.projectFact, produced MemoryProvenance.observed, or used MemoryWriteSource.verifiedToolEvidence; ContradictionDetector was unreachable because the only live subject was the globally unique intent:<uuid>; ReferenceResolver.explicitlyConfirmedTargetID had no producer; and AuraKernel.deleteMemoryRecord discarded the engine's MemoryDeletionReceipt. A bounded ToolObservation seam, a stable fact key with global scope, a reference-clarification round trip, and a surfaced deletion receipt were wired and covered by 19 new tests (full matrix 21/21 bundles, 1,160 tests, 0 failed). Live acceptance in an isolated CFFIXED_USER_HOME profile then produced a verified tool fact with observed provenance, a real contradiction plus its user-selected resolution, restart persistence, an authorized permanent deletion with a user-visible receipt, a live refusal of a risky action, and two socket-table transport traces with zero non-loopback peers. The final open scenario, multi-turn reference, was then traced to one guard: the rule-based classifier accepted an open-prefixed target only when it looked like a path, so 'open the file' became .unknown and the resolver was unreachable. A known reference phrase now yields the intent with its target slot empty, and the phrase list moved to a single AuraCore definition. Live: 'open the file' refused to guess between two candidates and asked; 'open the file alpha' resolved to alpha, bound filePath, and opened the real file. Full matrix 21/21 bundles, 1,164 tests, 0 failed.
completed: Re-ran all eight R8 live/product scenarios against one build (fccf1520) in a single isolated profile, closing SP-019's completion gate.

Made reference resolution reachable in production: an open-prefixed reference phrase now yields .fileOpen/.appActivate with its target slot empty, and the implicit-reference phrase list is defined once in AuraCore.
Wired a bounded ToolObservation seam from ToolRouter through IntentDispatchCoordinator into memory as a globally scoped projectFact with .observed provenance and a stable fact key.
Added the multi-turn reference clarification round trip so an ambiguous reference's answer populates explicitlyConfirmedTargetID only when it names exactly one offered candidate.
Returned and surfaced the MemoryDeletionReceipt through the kernel, app model, and Privacy tab, and fixed the VoiceOver label that had hidden its content.
Added scripts/run-sp019-transport-probe.sh, a read-only socket-table probe for the live process.
Captured live acceptance for verified tool fact, contradiction and resolution, restart persistence, authorized deletion with receipt, risky-action refusal, and transport silence.
